liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **He Was A Friend Of Mine** (2 reviews): The source singles out a beautiful version of He Was A Friend Of Mine; A thirteen-minute exploratory He Was A Friend Of Mine featured Dark Star tinged riffs [8][9]
- **Good Lovin'** (2 reviews): Jerry took lead vocals on Good Lovin', with Pig singing backup lines; This is one of the few Good Lovin's heard with Jerry singing lead [9][13]
- **It's All Over Now** (2 reviews): It's All Over Now was a rare performance for the band in 1969; The source describes It's All Over Now as a favorite Bobby tune that rocks [9][14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Big Boy Pete**: back after 143 archived shows (1010 days); rare: 11 archived performances [17]
- Earliest performances in the archive: It's All Over Now [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-09-06.sbd.lai.1184.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 6 songs; 45 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1969-09-06.134413.sbd.samaratino.droncit.flac16**: soundboard; 6 songs; 44 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: The Friend of Mine version is laid back with nice keys accompanying Jer's twangy solos [16]
- **gd69-09-06.sbd.samaritano.16608.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 6 songs; 45 min; rated 3.1/5 by 10 [3]. Said about its sound: Garcia's tone is rock solid and incredibly strong despite the band walking through numbers; The recording sounds pretty good, with the Schoolgirl track being pretty decent; The first three tracks exhibit low volume levels and authentic tape hiss [5][7][11][12]
- **gd1969-09-06.135153.sbd.SFNights.flac16**: soundboard; 2 songs; 16 min; rated 2/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- This performance comes from a missing reel, with the beginning and end in circulation [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-09-06.sbd.lai.1184.sbefail.shnf**: source: sdb> reel master> cassette> dat> cdr [1]
- **gd1969-09-06.134413.sbd.samaratino.droncit.flac16**: transferred by rematser by droncit; source: Restored version of Grateful Dead portion of source ID 16608 ; Lineage given in shnid 16608: Ampex C-90 Master Cassette Soundboard (No… [2]
- **gd69-09-06.sbd.samaritano.16608.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Joe Samaritano; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Transferred from Ampex C-90 Master Cassette Soundboard to DAT, then CD, EAC, and SHN [3]
- **gd1969-09-06.135153.sbd.SFNights.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Unknown; source: no lineage known; from "San Franciscan Nights 2" [4]. Also: Taken from the San Franciscan Nights 2 compilation by the Hell's Honkies Tape Club [4]
